_help: Starter dinners. weight: light | medium | hearty. Ingredients: g = product group (from your order history, see item_groups.csv), fb = fallback Woolworths product if you haven't bought that group before, p = a specific product. extras = pantry items (listed, not auto-added). Add your own recipes or import from Paprika.

recipes.name: Beef & veg stir-fry
method: Toss beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and half the Mingle base.
Heat a wok until smoking with a little oil. Stir-fry beef in two batches, 1–2 min each, then remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables and buk choy for 3 min.
Return beef, add remaining Mingle base mixed with 1/3 cup water, remaining soy and sesame oil. Toss 1 min until glossy.
Serve over heated microwave rice.

ing.p: Woolworths cook stir fry mix traditional vegetables 400g
Mingle sweet & savoury chow mein recipe base 40g

ing.fb: Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack

recipes.name: Bolognese pasta bake
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Cook penne 2 min less than packet time; drain.
Brown onion and garlic in a large pan, add mince and cook until browned.
Add passata and oregano, simmer 10 min. Season.
Stir pasta through the sauce, tip into a baking dish and cover with cheese.
Bake 15–20 min until bubbling and golden.

ing.fb: Woolworths heart smart extra lean beef mince 500g
Woolworths prep set go diced frozen onions 500g
Gourmet garden cold blend pastes garlic value 120g

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowls
method: Toss chicken with taco seasoning and a little oil. Pan-fry 5–6 min each side until cooked; rest and slice.
Warm the black beans with a pinch of seasoning.
Heat rice; squeeze through half the lime.
Build bowls: rice, beans, chicken, capsicum, tomato, sliced avocado.
Top with sour cream and lime wedges.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g
Dairy farmers sour cream squeeze pouch 130g
Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack

recipes.name: Thai red chicken curry
amounts: 3 tbsp Ayam Thai red curry paste
method: Fry curry paste in a little oil for 1 min until fragrant.
Add chicken and stir to coat, 3 min.
Pour in coconut cream and ½ cup water; simmer 10 min.
Add capsicum and buk choy for the last 4 min. Season with fish sauce.
Serve with rice.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken thigh skinless fillets small
Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack

recipes.name: Butter chicken with naan
method: Toss chicken in the Mingle base and brown in a little oil, 5 min.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 min.
Stir in cream and simmer 5 min until thick.
Warm naans in the oven or a dry pan.
Serve with rice, naan and pappadums.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken thigh skinless fillets small

ing.p: Simson's pantry mini naans plain 5 pack

ing.fb: Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack

ing.p: Patak's ready to eat pappadums mini plain original 75g

recipes.name: Slow-cooked beef with mash
amounts: 700g gravy beef or chuck, in large chunks
method: Heat oven to 160°C. Brown beef well in batches in an ovenproof pot.
Soften onion, add tomato paste and cook 1 min.
Return beef, add carrots, thyme and stock to just cover.
Cover and bake 2½–3 hr until the beef falls apart.
Microwave the Birds Eye mash as per packet (about 8–10 min on high, stirring halfway). Serve with the beef and gravy.

ing.fb: Woolworths prep set go diced frozen onions 500g

recipes.name: Confit duck legs with mash & greens
method: Heat oven to 200°C. Place duck legs skin-side up on a lined tray; roast 20–25 min until crisp.
Microwave the Birds Eye mash as per packet (about 8–10 min on high, stirring halfway).
Steam or blanch broccolini 3 min.
Serve duck on mash with broccolini; spoon over any pan juices.

ing.p: Luv-a-duck confit duck legs slow cooked 450g

recipes.name: Lamb chops, mash & three veg
method: Season chops and pan-fry or grill 3–4 min each side; rest 5 min.
Steam carrots 8 min, add broccoli for the last 4 min.
Microwave the Birds Eye mash as per packet (about 8–10 min on high, stirring halfway). Make gravy as per packet.
Serve chops with mash, vegetables, gravy and mint sauce.

recipes.name: Greek chicken traybake
method: Heat oven to 210°C.
Toss drumsticks and sweet potato with oil and the Mingle seasoning on a large tray. Roast 25 min.
Add zucchini, capsicum and tomatoes; roast another 20 min until chicken is cooked through.
Squeeze over lemon and serve.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken drumsticks bulk 1.1kg -

recipes.name: Korean beef bulgogi bowls
method: Mix soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and 1 tbsp ssamjang; marinate beef 10 min.
Stir-fry beef in a very hot pan in batches, 1–2 min each.
Toss coleslaw with a splash of soy and sesame oil.
Serve beef over rice with slaw, sliced spring onion and extra ssamjang.

ing.fb: Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack

recipes.name: Nasi goreng with fried egg
amounts: 6 microwave rice cups (3 × 2-packs), cold if possible
method: Stir-fry chicken in a hot wok until cooked; add vegetables for 3 min.
Add rice, breaking it up, and fry 3–4 min.
Stir through kecap manis and chilli sauce.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Serve rice topped with a fried egg each.

ing.fb: Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack
Good farmer 12 extra large free range eggs 700g
Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g

ing.p: Woolworths cook stir fry mix traditional vegetables 400g
Abc kecap manis sweet soy sauce 275ml

recipes.name: Pork larb lettuce cups
method: Dry-fry mince in a hot pan, breaking up, until cooked and slightly crisp.
Off the heat, stir in lime juice, fish sauce and chilli.
Toss through spring onion and chopped coriander.
Spoon into lettuce cups to serve.

ing.p: Woolworths fresh herb coriander bunch each

recipes.name: Shakshuka with chorizo & fetta
method: Fry chorizo in a deep pan until crisp; remove.
Soften capsicum in the chorizo oil, 5 min. Add cumin and paprika.
Add passata and chorizo; simmer 10 min.
Make 6 wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 6–8 min until whites set.
Scatter fetta and serve with toasted sourdough.

ing.fb: Good farmer 12 extra large free range eggs 700g

recipes.name: Greek pastitsio
method: Heat oven to 180°C. Cook pasta 2 min less than packet time; drain.
Brown onion and mince, add tomatoes and cinnamon; simmer 15 min.
Béchamel: melt butter, stir in flour 1 min, whisk in milk until thick. Stir in half the cheese.
Layer half the pasta, all the meat, the rest of the pasta, then the béchamel. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 35 min until golden. Rest 10 min before cutting.

ing.fb: Woolworths heart smart extra lean beef mince 500g
Woolworths prep set go diced frozen onions 500g

recipes.name: Chorizo & spinach risoni
method: Fry chorizo until crisp, add garlic for 30 sec.
Add risoni and stir to coat.
Add stock a cup at a time, stirring, until absorbed and tender (about 12 min).
Stir through spinach until wilted, then parmesan. Season.

ing.fb: Perfect italiano parmesan cheese grated extra sharp 125g

recipes.name: Gnocchi & chorizo traybake
method: Heat oven to 220°C.
Toss everything except basil on a large lined tray with oil and seasoning.
Roast 25–30 min, tossing halfway, until gnocchi are golden and tomatoes burst.
Scatter basil to serve.

recipes.name: Chicken tortilla soup
amounts: 1 cup corn chips, crushed, to serve
method: Bring stock, tomatoes and cumin to a simmer. Add chicken and poach 15 min.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks and return to the pot.
Add beans and corn; simmer 5 min. Season.
Serve topped with avocado, sour cream and crushed corn chips.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g
Dairy farmers sour cream squeeze pouch 130g

ing.p: Edgell australian grown corn kernels 125g x 4 pack

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
method: Simmer passata with chilli for 5 min to make a quick salsa.
Warm beans with a pinch of salt; lightly mash.
Fry the eggs.
Warm tortillas. Top with beans, eggs, salsa and sliced avocado.

ing.fb: Good farmer 12 extra large free range eggs 700g

ing.p: Old el paso family tortilla fajita wraps 16 pack

recipes.name: Mexican stuffed capsicums
amounts: 1 sachet Mingle taco spice mix (from the pantry)
optional: 60g baby spinach, for a side salad
method: Heat oven to 190°C. Put capsicum halves cut-side up in a baking dish.
Brown mince, add taco mix and ¼ cup water; simmer 3 min.
Stir in heated rice and beans (plus corn and zucchini, if using).
Fill capsicums, top with cheese and cover with foil.
Bake 25 min, uncover and bake 10 min more until golden.
extras: Mingle taco spice mix (you have it)

ing.fb: Woolworths heart smart extra lean beef mince 500g

ing.p: Edgell australian grown corn kernels 125g x 4 pack

recipes.name: Chicken laksa
method: Fry curry paste 1 min, add coconut cream and stock; simmer 5 min.
Add chicken and simmer 8 min until cooked. Add buk choy for the last 2 min.
Soak vermicelli in boiling water 5 min; drain.
Season broth with fish sauce and lime.
Divide noodles into bowls, ladle over laksa, top with bean sprouts.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g

recipes.name: Thai red pumpkin soup
method: Fry curry paste 1 min in a large pot.
Add pumpkin and stock; simmer 20 min until soft.
Add most of the coconut cream and blend until smooth.
Serve swirled with the remaining coconut cream and warm naan.

ing.p: Simson's pantry mini naans plain 5 pack

recipes.name: Keema curry with roti
amounts: 1 jar Patak's korma curry simmer sauce (450g)
method: Soften onion and garlic, add mince and brown well.
Stir in the simmer sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 min.
Add peas for the last 5 min.
Serve with warmed roti.

ing.fb: Woolworths heart smart extra lean beef mince 500g
Woolworths prep set go diced frozen onions 500g
Gourmet garden cold blend pastes garlic value 120g

ing.p: Supreme foods roti bread canai 500g x 4 pack

recipes.name: Cottage pie
method: Heat oven to 200°C.
Microwave the Birds Eye mash as per packet (about 8–10 min on high, stirring halfway) while you make the filling.
Soften onion and carrot (plus celery, if using), 5 min. Add mince (plus mushrooms, if using) and brown.
Stir in tomato paste, worcestershire and stock; simmer 15 min until thick. Stir in peas, if using.
Tip into a baking dish, spread the hot mash over the top, rough it up with a fork and scatter with cheese.
Bake 20 min until golden.

ing.fb: Woolworths heart smart extra lean beef mince 500g
Woolworths prep set go diced frozen onions 500g

recipes.name: Beef ragù pappardelle
amounts: ½ cup grated parmesan, to serve
method: Brown beef well in a heavy pot.
Add wine and bubble 1 min, then passata, stock and rosemary.
Cover and simmer on low (or 160°C oven) 2½–3 hr until tender.
Shred beef in the sauce with two forks.
Cook pappardelle, toss with ragù and serve with parmesan.

ing.fb: Perfect italiano parmesan cheese grated extra sharp 125g

recipes.name: Duck fried rice
method: Crisp shredded duck in a hot wok; remove.
Scramble eggs in the wok; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables 3 min, add rice and fry 3 min.
Return duck and egg, add soy and spring onion; toss well and serve.

ing.p: Luv-a-duck confit duck legs slow cooked 450g

ing.fb: Sunrice microwave white long grain rice cup 125g x 2 pack
Good farmer 12 extra large free range eggs 700g

ing.p: Woolworths cook stir fry mix traditional vegetables 400g

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki wraps
method: Toss chicken with lemon juice, oregano, garlic and oil.
Tzatziki: mix ½ cup yoghurt with grated cucumber, lemon and salt.
Pan-fry or grill chicken 3–4 min each side.
Fill warm wraps with chicken, tomato, cucumber, fetta and tzatziki.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g
Jalna pot set sweet & creamy greek style yoghurt 480g

recipes.name: Zucchini, spinach & fetta frittata
method: Heat oven grill to high.
Soften zucchini in an ovenproof pan, 3 min; wilt spinach.
Scatter ham, pour over beaten, seasoned eggs and dot with fetta.
Cook on low 10 min until almost set.
Finish under the grill 3–5 min until golden.

ing.fb: Good farmer 12 extra large free range eggs 700g

recipes.name: Chicken parmigiana & chips
method: Heat oven to 220°C and cook chips as per packet.
Crumb chicken: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry 3 min each side until golden; place on a tray.
Top with passata, ham and cheese; bake 10–12 min until cooked through and bubbling.
Serve with chips.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g
Mccain pub style extra crispy chips 750g

recipes.name: Duck breast with cherry sauce
amounts: 1 cup morello cherries plus ¼ cup syrup
method: Score duck skin, season, and place skin-side down in a cold pan. Cook on medium 8–10 min until crisp; flip for 3 min. Rest.
Pour off most fat, add cherries, syrup and balsamic; bubble 3–4 min to a glaze.
Microwave the Birds Eye mash as per packet (about 8–10 min on high, stirring halfway) and steam broccolini.
Slice duck and serve with mash, greens and cherry sauce.
shares: Confit duck legs with mash & greens

recipes.name: Chicken & bacon caesar salad
amounts: ½ cup shaved or grated parmesan
method: Pan-fry chicken 5–6 min each side; rest and slice.
Fry bacon until crisp; break into pieces.
Toss lettuce with dressing, croutons and most of the parmesan.
Top with chicken, bacon and remaining parmesan.

ing.fb: Woolworths rspca approved chicken breast fillet per 300g
Bertocchi traditional flat pancetta with black pepper 250g -
Perfect italiano parmesan cheese grated extra sharp 125g

recipes.name: Beef meatballs with pappardelle
method: Brown meatballs in a deep pan, 5 min, turning.
Add garlic for 30 sec, then passata and oregano.
Cover and simmer 15 min until meatballs are cooked through. Stir in spinach, if using.
Cook pappardelle as per packet; drain, keeping a little pasta water.
Toss pasta through the sauce, loosening with pasta water. Serve with parmesan.

ing.p: Harvey beef 20 pack parsley & garlic meatballs 420g

ing.fb: Perfect italiano parmesan cheese grated extra sharp 125g
